messages:
sara_sales: Prospective customer (MediCore) wants an isolated POC. Requirements: air-gapped installer, signed artifacts verifiable against their FIPS 140-2 HSM root, monthly security patches but quarterly manual installs, and a test plan for chain-of-custody. They also asked for an updated rate card for on-call support during cutover. Can we outline options?

dan_se: We can do three signing options: (1) they sign in their HSM (we provide unsigned artifacts + signing guide), (2) we sign with our key and provide a notarized attestation + chain, (3) co-sign workflow (we sign, then they re-sign with their HSM). Option 3 is best for mutual verification but more build complexity. Note: co-signning means CI needs ability to produce artifacts without embedding keys.

kevin_poc: On delivery: we usually ship an OCI-style bundle or a tarball plus detached signature. For airgap we can also provide a manifest.txt with SHA512s and a human-readable integrity sheet printed on tamper-evident media. Example verify commands we hand to customers:
```
# checksum
sha512sum redwood-offline-v1.2.tar.gz
# verify PKCS7 detached sig
openssl cms -verify -in redwood-offline-v1.2.tar.gz.sig -inform DER -content redwood-offline-v1.2.tar.gz -CAfile medi_core_root.pem
```
If they prefer cosign we can provide cosign-signed OCI indexes.

tess_infosec: A couple of policy points: (A) if we sign and hand over private keys, not acceptable. (B) If they want us to sign with their root, they must provide a verification policy and a revocation plan. We'll need an SOC2 addendum for POC if logs or telemetry are disabled. Also ask whether they require NIST SP 800-53 or just FIPS validated crypto.

phil_ops: Disk footprint ask (<100GB) ok with quantized models. We'll run a model-size audit for the requested variant. Also: for quarterly manual installs we recommend a delta patch approach for critical CVEs — small binary diffs signed the same way. Delta patches require an automated QA job to avoid drift.

sara_sales: Pricing question: they want 3-month POC with engineer standby during the cutover window. Ballpark?

billing_bot: Pricing stub: one-time packaging/config: $18,500 (includes signing integration + acceptance test kit). POC support: $4,500/month (includes 24x5 remote standby). Onsite day rate: $2,000/day. Final quote subject to SOW.

dan_se: Acceptance test we should hand them (minimal):
- verify signature + sha512s match manifest
- boot the appliance in isolated network and assert model loads pinned variant
- run sample inference smoke test (3 queries) with matching token counts
- verify update-disabled flag (no outbound attempts)
- perform rollback from previous image and confirm state restore
I can produce a test harness script they can run offline.

kevin_poc: Draft offline delivery contents I'll prepare:
- redwood-offline-v1.2.tar.gz
- redwood-offline-v1.2.tar.gz.sig (PKCS7/DER) or cosign attestations
- manifest.txt (sha512s, model-pin, runtime-config)
- install-readme.md (verification steps + example commands)
- chain-of-custody.pdf (USB handoff template)

sara_sales: Another blocker they raised: licensing for bundled model weights in an airgapped environment. They want assurance we can ship quantized weights for the pinned variant under their corporate license. Can legal draft a short model-licensing addendum?

tess_infosec: We'll need to confirm the model provider license allows redistribution in a sealed appliance. If not, the customer will need to sign a separate redistrib license. Also confirm whether telemetry is zeroed out; by default offline installs send no telemetry.

phil_ops: Timeline-wise: if we agree signing flow and they provide CA certs, we can prepare a signed test bundle within 10 business days. If they require co-sign or HSM integration on our CI, add 15 business days.

sara_sales: Great. Action items: (1) @kevin_poc produce delivery pack + sample manifest by Tue, (2) @tess_infosec check redistribution/license caveats and draft addendum, (3) @dan_se share acceptance test script and quickstart, (4) @billing_bot produce formal SOW line items. I'll send this to MediCore with provisional numbers. :white_check_mark:
